# ATOM schedule

[disaggregation.yaml](disaggregation.yaml) calls the [ATOM disaggregation workflow](../../../frameworks/atom/README.md) every day at 16:00 UTC.

The called workflow retains its external checkout and platform requirements. This file changes the recurring invocation only; it does not redefine the workload or establish remote execution coverage.

Return to the [workflow source guide](../../../README.md).
